title: ABS-CBN, BMSG, and XOXO Entertainment join forces to take Asian pop to wider audiences

blocks.text: The Philippines’ ABS-CBN, Japan’s BMSG, and Thailand’s XOXO Entertainment have joined forces for the inaugural “ASIA POP GIRL FEST 2027,” bringing together three entertainment companies and three leading girl groups to champion Asian pop music beyond their home markets.
